Translation of an article published in "the Diamond"
mosquito newspaper on May 6, 1931.

Indecent Acts from a Legal Point of View

Immoral customs are prevalent in
Shanghai. In this city, the number of prostitutes,
who might be divided into three classes---low, middle,
and high---is surprising. Specific stipulations
relating to prostitution are not to be found in the
Criminal Code, but if a legal action is to be taken,
the articles of the law that are nearest the offence
are applied.

Offences of sexual inversion such
as sodomy and intercourse between females are also
not specifically mentioned in the law, though all persons
concerned in such offences should be severely punished.
The only article in the Criminal Code which can be
applied is the one relating to indecency.

The term "indecency" has a very wide
meaning. To explain what acts are indecent is not
easy. Therefore, only some of the noted indecent
acts are given below:-

(1) Sodomy is usually committed
between man and man, wherein one of the parties is to
take the place of a woman. This is an unnatural
sexual intercourse. In Western countries, this
act is not punishable under the heading of adultery
but under special provisions; whilst in our country
it is punishable under the heading of adultery(?? Indecency)
because there were no special provisions in the old
Criminal Code (???). In fact, sodomy might be
charged under adultery because it is sometimes
committed between man and woman. Some men are fond
of committing sodomy with prostitutes.

1931年5月6日刊登于小报《钻石》（The Diamond）的一篇文章的译文。

从法律角度看猥亵行为

上海的不道德风俗盛行。在这座城市里，妓女的数量惊人，她们可分为三等——下等、中等和上等。刑法典中找不到关于卖淫的具体规定，但如果要采取法律行动，则适用与罪行最接近的法律条款。

法律也未特别提及性倒错罪行，如鸡奸和女性之间的性交，尽管所有涉及此类罪行的人都应受到严厉惩罚。刑法典中唯一可适用的条款是关于猥亵行为的条款。

“猥亵”一词含义非常广泛。解释哪些行为属于猥亵并不容易。因此，下面仅列举一些著名的猥亵行为：-

(1) 鸡奸通常发生在男性之间，其中一方扮演女性的角色。这是一种非自然的性行为。在西方国家，这种行为不以通奸罪论处，而是根据特别规定处罚；而在我国，由于旧刑法典中没有特别规定，这种行为以通奸罪（?? 猥亵）论处。事实上，鸡奸有时也发生在男女之间，因此可以按通奸罪起诉。有些男人喜欢与妓女进行鸡奸。

page_data.en:
(2)

(2) Sexual Intercourse between women
In the well known hotels in Shanghai, women can be
sent for to perform co-sexual intercourse. The charge
ranges from $20 to $30. As this act affects public
morality, the law prohibits it.
（批：This presumably refers to "stage witches" in tights. [签名]）
(3) Naked Dance In order to promote
business, cinema theatres always engage naked dancers to
perform. This is also prohibited by law.
(4) Masturbation, and sexual intercourse
between men( or women) and animals.
In Shanghai, masturbation and man-animal intercourse
have not yet been made a profession. These acts
are punished by law according to the nature of the case.

Translated by Zung Zoong Oen,
Section 5.
page_data.zh:
(2)

(2) 女性之间的性交
在上海的知名酒店中，可以叫来女性进行同性性交。费用在20至30元之间。由于这种行为影响公共道德，法律予以禁止。
（批注：这大概是指穿着紧身衣的“舞台女巫”。[签名]）
(3) 裸体舞 为了促进生意，电影院总是聘请裸体舞者表演。这也为法律所禁止。
(4) 手淫，以及人与动物之间的性交。
在上海，手淫和人兽性交尚未成为一种职业。这些行为根据案件性质依法惩处。

由第五科 Zung Zoong Oen 翻译。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Special Branch S.5. SENIOR
REPORT
Date May 11. 19 31

Subject (in full) Extract from Mosquito Newspaper
entitled " The Diamond".

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. J.W.Prince.

Sir,
Inquiries show that the attached newspaper extract
was taken from a mosquito newspaper entitled "The Diamond", May 6,
issue, a copy of which is attached.
Although this article refers to matters of an indecent
nature it does not appear to be sufficiently indecent in itself
that the publication of it constitutes an offence under the New
Press Laws.

J.W.Prince
C. D. I.
Officer I/c, Special Branch.

TRANSLATION.

Indecent act from the Legal Point of View.

It is an undeniable fact that prostitution is very
common in Shanghai. There are three classes, namely, High,
Medium and Low classes. Number of persons involved is surprising.
In law there is no specific provisions prohibiting the same. It
happened that some cases are brought before the Court, but they
are disposed of in a very general way and not in accordance with
any specific provisions of the law. For instance in cases of
SEXUAL INTERCOURSE BETWEEN WOMAN AND WOMAN etc. not only the
parties concerned will be punished and those who employ or
engaged them will be punished as well. The act is not specified
in law but it is involved in 'INDECENT ACT'. The interpretation
of 'Indecent Act' is very broad. What kind of act does it
actually mean? It is very troublesome to enumerate every one
of them. I, therefore, only mention some of the most noted
ones for the information of the readers.

SODOMY. Generally, it means sexual intercourse between
man and man. The law looks at it as an extra-ordinary sexual
intercourse. Evidently one of them takes the place of a woman.
In western countries the act is not punishable under the heading
of adultery but under special provisions. In our old criminal
law, there was no provision for this act. The act, as a matter
of fact, is involved in Adultery. There are also cases wherein
the act was committed between man and woman. The law classifies
them under the heading of indecency.

SEXUAL INTERCOURSE BETWEEN WOMEN AND WOMAN. In hotels
these women can be sent for performance. The cost will $20 to
$30. As it effects public morality, the act is punishable by law.

NAKED DANCE. In order to promote their business, Cinemas
always engage naked dancers for performances. As it effects
public morality, the law prohibits it.

MASTURBATION, AND SEXUAL INTERCOURSE BETWEEN PERSONS AND
ANIMALS. This can also be found in Shanghai. Such act is
punishable by law according to circumstances.

从法律角度看猥亵行为。

卖淫在上海非常普遍，这是一个不可否认的事实。分为三等，即高等、中等和低等。涉及人数惊人。法律中没有禁止此类行为的具体规定。确实有一些案件被提交法庭，但处理得非常笼统，并不依据任何具体的法律规定。例如，在女性与女性之间的性交等案件中，不仅当事人会受到惩罚，雇佣或招揽她们的人也会受到惩罚。法律未具体规定该行为，但它包含在“猥亵行为”之中。“猥亵行为”的解释非常广泛。它实际上指哪种行为？逐一列举非常麻烦。因此，我只提及一些最著名的行为，供读者参考。

鸡奸。通常指男性之间的性交。法律视其为一种特殊的性行为。显然，其中一人扮演女性的角色。在西方国家，该行为不以通奸罪论处，而是根据特别规定处罚。在我国旧刑法中，没有针对此行为的规定。事实上，该行为包含在通奸罪中。也有男女之间发生此行为的案例。法律将其归类为猥亵罪。

女性与女性之间的性交。在酒店中，可以叫来这些女性进行表演。费用为20至30美元。由于它影响公共道德，该行为依法受罚。

裸体舞。为了促进生意，电影院总是聘请裸体舞者进行表演。由于它影响公共道德，法律予以禁止。

手淫，以及人与动物之间的性交。在上海也能发现此类行为。此类行为根据具体情况依法惩处。

Page 82 to 91

"Then let us go to the Derling Dancing Hall", said
Burteel.
"Since I have come to-night, " replied Miss Mary,
"I will allow you to do anything you please and will go
anywhere you like."
Miss Mary's idea was quite clear to Burteel who,
however, was a little surprised. It was about 8 p.m.
when they entered the Derling Dancing Hall, and as it was
yet too early, they sat down on a sofa and had a secret
talk. Sometime later, persons began to come in and
the girls wore very thin clothing. Burteel said to
Mary that the Dancing Hall was really a "great door of
soul and flesh".
While watching the dances, Burteel gave Mary a
very passionate kiss and said, "The men and the women who
have come to this place are full of the 'sparks of soul and
flesh' and are moved by the force of self-combustion. They
have come not for dancing but for extinguishing their 'fire'."
Upon hearing this, Miss Mary said with a smile,
"Does your 'sparks of soul and flesh' sometimes combust?
How do you extinguish your 'fire' ? "
"I have not yet found any means to extinguish the
'fire' which has caused me considerable suffering. This is
responsible for the suspension of my studies as I have not
been able to make any progress in my learning owing to the
lonesome feelings."
The Derling Dancing Hall was well known for naked
dances. These dances took place at midnight when the
dancers took off all their clothing and pressed their
"flesh" tightly against one another. They did more than
kissing and xxx embracing. That night Miss Marry and
Mr. Burteel did the same thing and they did not stop until
dawn. Miss Mary was fatigued but she felt exceedingly
comfortable throughout her whole body. This experience
gave both of them a very deep impression.

Page 149 to Page 155

Miss Mary said to Mr. Price, "This is a photograph
of my naked body. You can see all the beauties of my
physical constitution. As I have not a photograph of a
whole naked man, I hope you will give me one of yours."
Seeing that the opportunity had come, Mr. Price
informed Miss Marry that it was time for him to sleep and
Mary replied that they had better go to the Victoria Hotel.
They then went out together.
The Victoria Hotel was different from other
hotels; men and women must go there in pairs. In this Hotel
there was a dancing hall called "The Black Dancing Hall"
where the men and women were naked and could do anything
they pleased. They were also allowed to change their
companions freely. The Hall was really a large sleeping
bed.

Laim's girl ordered Laim to lie down on a soft
bed and pulled off his clothing, after which she stripped
herself. While she was undressing, Laim, though he felt
shy, looked at her naked body for more than 15 minutes.

第82页至91页

“那我们去德林舞厅吧，”伯蒂尔（Burteel）说。
“既然我今晚来了，”玛丽小姐回答道，“我允许你做你想做的任何事，去你想去的任何地方。”
伯蒂尔很清楚玛丽小姐的想法，但他还是有点惊讶。他们进入德林舞厅时大约是晚上8点，因为时间还早，他们坐在沙发上秘密交谈。过了一会儿，人们开始进来，女孩们穿着非常单薄的衣服。伯蒂尔对玛丽说，这个舞厅真是一个“灵肉的大门”。
观看舞蹈时，伯蒂尔给了玛丽一个非常热情的吻，并说：“来到这里的男男女女都充满了‘灵肉的火花’，并被自燃的力量所感动。他们来这里不是为了跳舞，而是为了熄灭他们的‘火’。”
听到这话，玛丽小姐笑着说：“你的‘灵肉火花’有时会燃烧吗？你是如何熄灭你的‘火’的？”
“我还没有找到熄灭这‘火’的方法，这给我造成了相当大的痛苦。这也是我学业中断的原因，因为孤独感使我无法在学业上取得任何进步。”
德林舞厅以裸体舞闻名。这些舞蹈在午夜进行，舞者脱掉所有衣服，将他们的“肉体”紧紧贴在一起。他们做的不仅仅是亲吻和 xxx 拥抱。那天晚上，玛丽小姐和伯蒂尔先生做了同样的事情，直到黎明才停止。玛丽小姐感到疲惫，但她觉得全身极其舒适。这次经历给他们两人都留下了非常深刻的印象。

第149页至155页

玛丽小姐对普赖斯（Price）先生说：“这是我裸体的照片。你可以看到我身体结构的所有美感。由于我没有一张全裸男性的照片，我希望你能给我一张你的。”
看到机会来了，普赖斯先生告诉玛丽小姐是他睡觉的时候了，玛丽回答说他们最好去维多利亚酒店。然后他们一起出去了。
维多利亚酒店与其他酒店不同；男女必须成对前往。这家酒店有一个名为“黑色舞厅”的舞厅，那里的男女都是裸体的，可以做他们想做的任何事。他们还被允许自由更换伴侣。这个舞厅真的是一张巨大的睡床。

第174页至176页

莱姆（Laim）的女孩命令莱姆躺在柔软的床上，并脱掉他的衣服，随后她也脱光了自己的衣服。在她脱衣服的时候，莱姆虽然感到害羞，但还是盯着她的裸体看了15分钟以上。

Soon afterwards, Laim and his girl left for the Black

As it was very dark in the Dancing Hall,
Laim had to hold his girl in his arms very tightly, his
